gapAnalysis.title: Playwright test suite covers GLB and FBX assets but lacks a dedicated .obj upload fixture
gapAnalysis.description: sveltekit-frontend/src/routes/(app)/demos/spz-renderer/+page.svelte implements OBJLoader dynamically on line 1165, but tests/e2e/spz-renderer-fixture.spec.ts only exercises .glb fixtures. An automated test uploading synthetic .obj Wavefront text is required to guard against browser bundle regressions.
gapAnalysis.remediation: Add a dedicated test case in tests/e2e/spz-renderer-fixture.spec.ts uploading synthetic .obj buffer to data-testid="local-asset-file-input".

gapAnalysis.title: Spatial CSR synthesis runs in C++ / Node.js batch scripts rather than live WebWorker / SharedArrayBuffer streaming to Three.js
gapAnalysis.description: simd-bridge/cpp/spatial_packet_synthesizer.cpp and scripts/atlas/sample-acp-sharedarraybuffer-bvh-flow-v1.mjs compute 64-byte CSR packets offline. The Three.js frontend currently re-parses geometry on the main thread via three-mesh-bvh without consuming pre-quantized 4-bit LSB feature textures directly.
gapAnalysis.remediation: Implement a WebGL2 DataTexture upload route in sveltekit-frontend/src/lib/splat/spatial-bvh-manager-v1.ts to consume pre-built CSR buffers directly from worker threads.

gapAnalysis.title: Centroid cache keys have three coexisting shapes in codebase (ace:centroid:*, centroid:feature:*, and gpu:autoencoder:centroids_64)
gapAnalysis.description: ace-bitfrost-cache-identity-v1.ts and centroid-artifact-v1.ts define durable CentroidArtifactV1 with cryptographic checksums, while prefilter.redis.ts reads legacy gpu:autoencoder:centroids_64. No single centroid writer is currently canonical across all three namespaces.
gapAnalysis.remediation: Promote centroid-artifact-v1.ts as the single canonical centroid schema and register an alias lookup bridge in SearchRuntime.

gapAnalysis.title: Background Node.js dev server on port 5173 entered CloseWait socket hang, requiring headless in-memory Playwright execution
gapAnalysis.description: A pre-existing Node.js process (PID 320) holding port 5173 had accumulated CloseWait sockets, blocking new HTTP GET requests. Playwright tests connecting directly to port 5173 timed out until executed in a self-contained in-memory WebGL2 page context.
gapAnalysis.remediation: Restart the dev server process cleanly (human operator task) and ensure Playwright tests use dynamic ephemeral ports or skip global DB teardown.
